title: Budget — Envelopes (rollover)
description: Envelope budgeting with rollover: unspent budget carries forward and overspending eats into it. The top list is every budgeted envelope with what's left in it — click any envelope to drill into its month-by-month trend below (available → spent → left). Defaults to the current year; choose a range with data.

steps.query: SELECT account, currency, SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) AS actual FROM postings WHERE account_type = 'Expenses' AND transaction_date BETWEEN :from AND :to AND currency = :currency GROUP BY account, currency

SELECT year_month AS period, SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) AS actual FROM postings WHERE (account = :account OR account LIKE :account || ':%') AND transaction_date BETWEEN :from AND :to AND currency = :currency GROUP BY year_month ORDER BY year_month

widgets.title: ✉ Envelope balances
widgets.helpText: Every budgeted envelope over the selected range: the bar is spent vs budget, and the amount on the right is what's left in the envelope (unspent budget that carries forward; red = overspent). Click an envelope to drill into its month-by-month trend below.

visualization.emptyText: No budgets or spending for this range. Set budgets in the Budgets view, then pick a range and currency that have data.

widgets.title: {{params.account:accountName}} — Available
widgets.helpText: The selected envelope's opening balance for the most recent month in range: last month's carryover plus this month's budget — what you had to spend.

widgets.title: {{params.account:accountName}} — Spent
widgets.helpText: What you actually spent from the selected envelope in the most recent month in range.

widgets.title: {{params.account:accountName}} — In envelope now
widgets.helpText: The selected envelope's closing balance after this month's spending (available − spent) — unspent budget that carries forward. Negative (red) means you overspent and the shortfall carries into next month.

widgets.title: {{params.account:accountName}} — Balance over time
widgets.helpText: The selected envelope's balance (carryover) at the end of each month. A rising line means you're banking unspent budget; dipping below zero means you overspent and are carrying a shortfall forward. Click a month's point to see that month's transactions.
